install: test -f /tmp/pip.whl || curl -sSfL -o /tmp/pip.whl "$(python3 -c "import json,urllib.request;d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/24.3.1/json'));print([u['url'] for u in d['urls'] if u['filename'].endswith('.whl')][0])")" && python3 /tmp/pip.whl/pip install --user --break-system-packages -q numpy==2.2.6 mypy ruff
test: bash -c "export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; echo '== extra'; DEV=CPU:X86 python3 osmogrep_extra_check.py; a=$?; echo '== frozen reproducer'; DEV=CPU:X86 python3 osmogrep_repro_jit_return_input.py; echo '== mypy'; python3 -m mypy tinygrad/ 2>&1 | tail -15; b=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo '== ruff'; python3 -m ruff check . 2>&1 | tail -15; c=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo '== skipped'; DEV=CPU:X86 python3 -m unittest -v test.runtime.test_jit test.runtime.test_symbolic_jit test.runtime.test_pickle 2>&1 | grep -E 'skipped|^Ran|^OK|^FAILED'; echo \"extra=$a mypy=$b ruff=$c\"; exit $((a|b|c))"
